correctness.rationale: The local CCA rule on a complete bipartite graph factors exactly through seven possible nonempty color supports on each part. On their 49 ordered pairs, a complete classification yields 10 recurrent support states and three exact depth matrices, checked directly in the supplied standard-library verifier. Periodic support dynamics entails bijective color-class maps, whose exact returns are identity at periods 1, 3, and 4, not merely support-cycle periods. The three on-to support-count weights establish all formulas for every positive pair of sizes. Direct vertex-wise enumeration independently reproduces periods and first-entry depths for 24,606 labeled configurations over 22 parameter pairs. Boundary sizes (1,1), (1,2), (2,2) and (3,3) are covered, and no finite experiment is substituted for the all-size support factorization.

The available sources and research-index comparison revealed no statement whose result implies the complete three-depth matrices and individual orbit counts; an unindexed equivalent remains possible.

value.rationale: The exact observable is the complete recurrent-state and first-entry-depth distribution for a natural finite network of three cyclically competing species. It exhibits coexisting period-three and period-four attractors, distinct thresholds at minimum part size three and two, a universal sharp two-update transient bound, and a computable dynamical zeta function. These are nontrivial invariants not determined by the established yes/no synchronization criterion; the infinite family is handled by an exact finite support factor that isolates its structural mechanism.
